title: Back Office Operations Executive
description:
**Back Office Operations Executive**  
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu \| Work from Office  
Shift Timing: Day Shift (Open to Night Shift)  
Department: Operations

**About the Role**  
We're hiring a Back Office Operations Executive who's quick, adaptable, and comfortable working with technology and data. You'll handle day\-to\-day operational tasks, work with spreadsheets and online tools, troubleshoot issues independently, and support internal processes efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle day\-to\-day back\-office and operational activities with speed and accuracy
* Work with Google Sheets, Google Workspace, and other online tools
* Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, etc. to boost productivity and solve operational tasks
* Identify issues, troubleshoot, and find practical solutions independently
* Maintain and update data, records, sheets, and operational trackers
* Learn new tools, processes, and workflows quickly
* Complete assigned tasks within timelines while maintaining accuracy
* Coordinate with internal teams as required
* Support other operational needs as they come up

**What We're Looking For**

* Good working knowledge of Google Sheets \& Google Workspace
* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, etc.
* Fast learner, able to work quickly and efficiently
* Strong problem\-solving and logical thinking
* Good attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Familiarity with Shopify is a plus
* Willingness to work day shifts, open to night shifts (from office)
* Good communication skills and a proactive approach

Someone who's quick, tech\-friendly, curious, and enjoys figuring things out — comfortable with AI and online tools, and ready to take ownership of getting things done.  
APPLY: https://hiredesk.backdropsource.app/apply/ca38923f\-21f9\-421e\-b7f9\-b853485391ec?src\=Indeed

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
